body: Hi! I'm Maya from Northbay Bottle Co. We love your kitchen-gadget Reels. We'd like to pay you $1,800 for 1 Reel and 3 Stories featuring our insulated bottle. body: Dear creator, Ravi from Vantora Mobile. We would like to commission one dedicated video for $1,500.
